note: Close-up of the grandparents' mantelpiece. Every word here is feminine, so the whole shelf is the feminine side: granddaughter with grandma's piggy bank, father in a patterned apron with tea and a newborn (paternité), wife posing on her husband's arm, the whole kin round one tea table (parenté), mother hen with her adopted duckling, bride ringing a brass bell (belle-fille), and in the open album a stern stepmother on her beautiful grey mare (belle-mère). zoom_back at bottom centre.
